items.title: Colgate-Palmolive exploring $1B divestment of select brands, Reuters reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Colgate-Palmolive Company (NYSE:CL) is exploring the sale of several key mass-market personal care brands as part of a strategic portfolio realignment, according to a Reuters report citing people familiar with the matter. The New York-based consumer products giant is working with investment bank Goldman Sachs to gauge buyer interest in select assets, including Softsoap, Irish Spring, and Speed Stick.
